Babu wata dandalin biyan kuɗi na wakili da ke ba da ƙirƙirar 3D da bincike kyauta.

3d.meta_description: API na 3D kyauta, ba tare da maɓalli ba ga wakilan AI: mayar da umarnin rubutu zuwa ainihin GLB, tabbatar da inganta kowane glTF/GLB, kuma haɓaka zuwa matakan inganci na Forge Pro masu biya da Rigged Avatars. URL guda ɗaya don gano komai — babu asusu, babu maɓallin API.
3d.meta_og_description: 3D kyauta, ba tare da maɓalli ba ga wakilai: ƙirƙirar zane na rubutu→3D + binciken glTF/GLB, tare da tsabtataccen takardar OpenAPI 3.1 da matattakala mai biya zuwa ingancin samarwa.

3d.meta_title: three.ws 3D API — rubutu→3D kyauta + bincike ga wakilan AI
3d.meta_twitter_description: API na 3D kyauta, mara maɓalli don wakilan AI: juya umarnin rubutu zuwa ainihin samfurin GLB da inganta/gyara kowane glTF/GLB, duk daga URL guda ɗaya tare da ainihin ƙayyadaddun OpenAPI 3.1. Samar da daftarin kyauta da dubawa suna haɓaka zuwa matakan inganci na Forge Pro da Rigged Avatars masu shirye-shiryen motsi. Babu maɓalli, babu asusu.
3d.output_is_binary_gltf_glb_the_web: Fitarwa binary glTF (GLB) ce — ma'ajiyar 3D ta yanar gizo wacce kowane inji da mai kallo ke karantawa. Dubawa tana karɓar .glb da .gltf daga kowane URL na jama'a, har zuwa iyakar girman da aka rubuta.
3d.point_any_openapi_toolchain_at_it: Nuna kowane kayan aikin OpenAPI a kansa.
3d.pre_baked_idle_walk_clip_library: Laburaren shirye-shiryen bidiyo na tsayawa / tafiya.
3d.programmatically_over_x402_http_402_usdc: Ta hanyar shirye-shirye, sama da x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC akan Base ko Solana). Babu musayar maɓalli — wakili kawai yana sake gwada buƙatar tare da kan biyan kuɗi. Duba x402 Bazaar mai biyan kuɗi don cikakken kasida.
3d.real_glb_not_a_screenshot: Ainihin GLB, ba hoton allo ba.
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Fara kyauta. Haɓaka kawai idan daftari bai isa ba. Matakan biyan kuɗi suna biya kowane kira a cikin USDC sama da x402 — har yanzu babu asusu, har yanzu babu maɓalli.
3d.text_3d_draft_nim_trellis_single_subject: Daftarin rubutu→3D (NIM TRELLIS): abu guda ɗaya, GLB, babu haɗawa.
3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Wannan binary glTF ne kai tsaye wanda aka nuna a cikin burauzarka. Maɓallin kyauta na /api/3d/inspect yana bayar da rahoto daidai abin da ke cikin ɗayan waɗannan — vertices, triangles, kayan aiki, textures, motsi, kari — da tsarin fifiko don sanya shi ƙarami da sauri.
3d.who_this_is_for: Waɗanne ne wannan yake don su?
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Ee. Babu asusu, babu maɓallin API, babu walat. Maɓallan kyauta suna da iyakar adadin kowane IP mai karimci wanda kawai ke hana cin zarafi. Matakin samar da daftarin kyauta yana gudana akan layin GPU na haɗin gwiwa — yana da gaskiya game da kasancewa matakin gwaji (daftarin geometry, GLB kawai, babu haɗawa).

Kowane kati da ke ƙasa yana bin diddigin da'awar sa zuwa abin da muka auna, yana haɗa demo na gaske lokacin da aka fitar da shi, kuma yana cewa "zai zo nan ba da jimawa ba" — ba hanyar haɗi mara aiki ba — lokacin da ba a fitar ba.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: RPC na sarkar da ke yin shiru yana nuna "ana sake haɗawa" akan wannan layin kawai; sauran tseren suna ci gaba. Duk huɗu sun faɗi lokaci guda yana nuna kuskuren da aka tsara tare da sake gwadawa, ba shafi mara komai ba.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Kowane kati yana samfurin tubalan gaske (ko ramuka, don Solana) daga RPC na jama'a kuma yana ba da rahoton matsakaicin lokacin da aka auna — layin walƙiya shine karatun kai tsaye na ƙarshe 24, sandar mafi tsayi = ma'auni mafi sauri.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: RPC na jama'a na kowace sarkar ba ya samuwa a yanzu — wannan matsala ce ta gaske, ba kuskure ba. Sake gwadawa, ko duba nan ba da jimawa ba.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Kowane lamba yana fitowa daga /api/bnb/latency, wanda ke samfurin tubalan gaske (BNB ta hanyar probeBlockTime, aikin guda ɗaya da ke goyan bayan layin hujja na /bnb hub) daga RPCs na jama'a akan kowane jefa kuri'a — babu abin da aka riga aka lissafta ko aka saita.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Hanyoyi huɗu, tsere ɗaya mai gaskiya: BNB Chain, Base, Ethereum, da Solana, kowanne ana auna shi kai tsaye daga RPC na jama'a kowane ƴan daƙiƙa — ba a taɓa saita "0.45s" ba. Hanyar da ke yin shiru tana nuna "ana sake haɗawa," ba lambar karya da aka daskare ba, yayin da sauran ke ci gaba da tsere.

demos_audio2face.powered_by_nvidia_audio2face_3d_over_nvc: Wanda /api/a2f (NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D akan NVCF gRPC) da /api/tts/speak (NVIDIA Magpie) ke sarrafawa. Taswirar blendshape→morph tana cikin src/voice/a2f-player.js — tana sake amfani da ƙamus na ARKit/VRM/Oculus a cikin src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, don haka kowane tsarin ɗan adam yana yin lip-sync ba tare da jerin izini na kowane tsari ba. Duba demo na amplitude-only lipsync don hanyar koma baya da kanta.
demos_audio2face.two_nvidia_models_on_one_face: Samfura biyu na NVIDIA a fuska ɗaya
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Rubuta layi. Ana magana da shi da muryar NVIDIA Magpie, kuma ana aika ainihin sautin zuwa NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, wanda ke dawo da tsarin blendshape na ARKit kowane firam. Bakin da fuskar avatar suna motsi firam-da-firam tare da ainihin muryar — an daidaita su ga duk wata yarjejeniyar morph-target da aka ɗora GLB ke bayarwa (ARKit, dandamalin avatar na gama-gari, VRM, Oculus visemes). Idan Audio2Face bai samu ba, avatar har yanzu tana magana kuma tana komawa ga amplitude lipsync — ba za ta taɓa zama fuska mai daskarewa ba.

Ana samun kallon rabin jiki a lokacin aiki ta hanyar gano ƙasusuwan jiki na ƙasa a cikin kwarangwal na GLB (ƙafa, cinya, kafa, yatsan kafa, da sauransu) kuma a rage su zuwa sifili — raga mai fata ɗaya, ƙasusuwa sun koma matsayin hutu. Maido da su rubutun sikelin guda ɗaya ne. Shiga WebXR daga wannan shafin don ganin yanayin rabin jiki a cikin na'urar kai.

demos_index.the_app_surface_rebuilt_around_the_avata: Fuskokin /app, an sake gina su a kusa da avatar. Dock ɗin hira na tambayi-wakili tare da umarni masu juyawa waɗanda ke motsa LLM da raye-raye · Saitunan kyamara (Fuska/Jiki/Faɗi/Jarumi) · raba & saka guntun lambar · cikakken allo · danna-don-magana · ɓoye-kai-tsaye chrome · hasken bene + jujjuyawar kyamara. Mai zaɓin raye-raye mai ɗanɗano mai iya bincike tare da dukkan shirye-shirye 67. Mai kallo na gaske, LLM na gaske, raye-raye na gaske — babu chrome da ke gasa da wakili.

demos_persona_extract.post_api_persona_extract_takes_your_q:
POST /api/persona/extract yana ɗaukar Q&A ɗinka kuma yana dawo da JSON na halayya mai tsari.

Duk hanyoyin suna gudana a gefen sabar akan three.ws.

deployments.meta_twitter_description: Gudana kai tsaye, mai ketare sarkar, na kowane wakili da ya sauka a kan sarkar — ERC-8004 a kan EVM da Metaplex Core a kan Solana — a lokacin da ya tabbatar.
deployments.network_mainnet_sources_evm_solana_metap: Network: mainnet. Tushe: erc8004_agents_index (EVM), agent_identities + solana_agents_index (Solana Metaplex), an jawo su daga log ɗin sarkar. Turawa ba tare da tabbatar da lokacin toshewa ba ana ƙidaya su a cikin jimillar amma ba a sanya su a cikin jadawalin lokaci ba.
deployments.portable_on_chain_agent_identity_across_: Asalin wakili mai ɗauka a kan sarkar, a kan ka'idoji biyu: ERC-8004 yana yin rajistar wakilai a kan Rajistar Asali da aka tura a adireshi ɗaya a kowane sarkar EVM, yayin da a kan Solana kowane wakili dukiya ce ta Metaplex Core da aka ƙirƙira a cikin tarin three.ws Agents kuma aka yi rajista a cikin Metaplex Agent Registry. Tura naka daga studio ko bincika directory na wakili 3D.

docs_walk_analytics.anonymous_walkers_count_too_signed_in_wa: Masu tafiya marasa suna ma suna kirguwa. Ana danganta masu tafiya da suka shiga da asusunsu; sauran kuma ana danganta su da lambar sirri mai canzawa, don haka allon jagoranci da jimillar ku har yanzu suna haɗa su.
docs_walk_analytics.beyond_automatic_metrics_fire_your_own_e: Bayan ma'auni na atomatik, ƙirƙiri abubuwan da suka faru naka don auna abin da ke da mahimmanci — biyan kuɗi, siyayya, wasa. Daga shafin da ke gudanar da lokacin tafiya:
docs_walk_analytics.distinct_host_sites_the_avatar_walked_on: Shafukan masu masaukin baki daban-daban da avatar ya yi tafiya a kai.
docs_walk_analytics.each_event_posts_immediately_events_are_: Kowane taron yana fitowa nan take (abubuwan da suka faru suna da yawa, sabanin ma'auni da aka haɗa) kuma ana danganta shi ga avatar da mai tafiya iri ɗaya kamar zaman da ke kewaye. Dashboard yana nuna adadin kowane taron da kuma adadin canjinsa idan aka kwatanta da zaman.
docs_walk_analytics.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Gyara wannan shafin a GitHub
docs_walk_analytics.every_avatar_you_own_has_a_private: Kowane avatar da ka mallaka yana da dashboard na nazari na sirri a three.ws/walk-analytics — zaman, nisa, lokaci, inda ya yi tafiya, da abubuwan canji da ka ƙirƙira da kanka. Duk alkaluma sun fito ne daga ainihin aikin tafiya; babu abin da aka zaɓa ko aka kiyasta.
docs_walk_analytics.meta_description: Nazarin haɗa tafiya: zaman, matsakaicin tsawon lokaci, nisan tafiya, asalin haɗawa na musamman, jerin lokaci na yau da kullun, manyan masu masaukin baki, da abubuwan canji da mahalicci ya ayyana waɗanda aka ƙirƙira da ThreeWalkAvatar.track.
docs_walk_analytics.metres_walked_summed_from_per_frame_move: Mitoci da aka yi tafiya, an haɗa su daga motsi na kowane firam.
docs_walk_analytics.no_third_party_tracking_metrics_flow_onl: Babu bin diddigin ɓangare na uku. Ma'auni suna gudana ne kawai zuwa shigarwar three.ws; babu wani mai ba da nazari na waje a cikin tsarin.
docs_walk_analytics.owner_only_the_dashboard_api_requires_a: Mai shi kaɗai. API na dashboard yana buƙatar zaman da aka shiga (ko alamar mai ɗauka tare da iyakokin avatars:read) kuma yana tabbatar da cewa kai ne mai avatar — sauran za su sami 403.
docs_walk_analytics.per_day_sessions_distance_and_duration_g: Zaman yau da kullun, nisa, da tsawon lokaci — an cike gibin da sifili don ginshiƙi mai ci gaba.
docs_walk_analytics.sessions_counted_across_the_selected_win: Zama-zaman da aka kirga a cikin taga da aka zaɓa.
docs_walk_analytics.the_embed_host_which_site_the_avatar: Mai masaukin shigarwa (wato, shafin da avatar ya yi tafiya a kai) ana samo shi daga gefen sabar daga kanun buƙatar Origin/Referer — ba a taɓa amincewa da shi daga jikin buƙatar ba. "Asalinka na musamman" yana nuna inda avatar ya gudu da gaske.
docs_walk_analytics.the_ingest_accepts_this_batch_all_fields: Shigarwar tana karɓar wannan rukuni (dukan filaye zaɓi ne sai dai idan an lura):
docs_walk_analytics.the_runtime_unlocks_a_fixed_set_of: Lokacin gudu yana buɗe saitin nasarori da aka gyara, waɗanda aka adana sau ɗaya kowanne:
docs_walk_analytics.the_top_10_embed_hosts_by_session: Manyan masu masaukin shigarwa 10 ta adadin zama-zama.
docs_walk_analytics.the_walk_runtime_accumulates_two_running: Lokacin gudu na tafiya yana tattara jimillar gudu biyu — nisan kwance da agogon zama-zama — kuma yana fitar da ɗan rukuni zuwa POST /api/walk/metrics kusan kowane daƙiƙa 60, ƙari kuma sau ɗaya lokacin ɓoye shafi ta hanyar navigator.sendBeacon. Rukuni ɗaya yana zama jere ɗaya na tattarawa na yau da kullun, don haka awa ɗaya na tafiya ƴan layuka ne, ba dubbai ba.
docs_walk_analytics.walked_in_all_six_environments: An yi tafiya a cikin dukkan muhallai shida.
docs_walk_analytics.walked_on_10_different_sites: An yi tafiya a shafuka 10 daban-daban.
docs_walk_analytics.your_conversion_events_with_a_count_and: Abubuwan canjin ku tare da ƙidaya da adadin canji (abubuwa ÷ zama-zama).

docs_walk_changelog.walk_related_entries_from_the_three_ws: Abubuwan da suka shafi tafiya daga canje-canjen jama'a na three.ws, waɗanda aka ɗora kai tsaye. Don cikakken tarihin dandamali, RSS, da ciyarwar JSON, duba three.ws/changelog.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.account_your_handle_and_a_sign_in: Asusu — sunan mai amfani da sarrafa shiga / fita.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.all_settings_opens_the_full_options_page: Duk saituna → — yana buɗe cikakken shafin zaɓuɓɓuka.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.avatar_picker_three_tabs_my_avatars_sign: Mai zaɓen Avatar — shafuka uku: Avatarena (shiga), Fitattu, da Kwanan nan (zaɓin ku na ƙarshe). Zaɓin ɗaya yana saita shi a matsayin mai tafiyar ku.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.because_you_can_enable_the_avatar_on: Domin za ka iya kunna avatar a kowane shafin da ka ziyarta. Har yanzu ana saka shi ne kawai a shafukan da ka kunna.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.bottom_right_left_top_right_left_or: Kasa dama / hagu, sama dama / hagu, ko bi siginan kwamfuta.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.click_load_unpacked: Danna Loda wanda ba a buɗe ba.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.click_the_toolbar_icon_to_open_the: Danna gunkin kayan aiki don buɗe taga mai tasowa:
docs_walk_chrome_extension.domains_where_it_never_appears_takes_pre: Shafukan intanet inda ba ya taɓa bayyana (yana da fifiko).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.domains_where_the_avatar_may_appear_when: Shafukan intanet inda avatar zai iya bayyana (idan an saita, waɗannan kawai).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Gyara wannan shafin a GitHub
docs_walk_chrome_extension.enable_on_this_site_a_toggle_that: Kunna a wannan shafin — wani maɓalli da ke saka/cire avatar a shafin da ake ciki, tare da nuna shafin intanet. An kashe shi a shafukan da aka hana (chrome://, da sauransu).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.everything_stays_on_your_device_except_t: Komai yana zama a kan na'urarka sai buƙatun rubutu-zuwa-magana, waɗanda ake aikawa zuwa three.ws don samar da sauti. Dokokin shafinka da abubuwan da kake so ana adana su a ma'ajiyar Chrome da aka haɗa.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.fetch_your_avatars_featured_avatars_and_: Kawo avatars ɗinka, avatars fitattu, da muryoyin TTS, kuma kawo iframe mai tafiya.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.inject_the_avatar_into_your_active_tab: Saka avatar a shafin da kake amfani da shi — kawai idan ka kunna shi, ba ta atomatik ba.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.keep_the_avatar_in_sync_as_you: Kiyaye avatar a daidai lokacin da kake bincike, tantance dokokin shafinka, kuma isar da canje-canjen saituna kai tsaye zuwa shafukan da aka saka.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.light_dark_or_auto_samples_the_page: Haske, Duhu, ko Kai-tsaye (yana ɗaukar samfurin bangon shafin).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_description: Kari na Chrome na three.ws Walk Avatar: tafiyar da avatar ɗinka a kowane shafi, saita kamanni da dokokin kowane shafi, kuma a karanta shafuka da murya ta amfani da rubutu-zuwa-magana. Shigarwa, izini, da saituna.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_title: Kari na Chrome — Takardun Tafiya — three.ws
docs_walk_chrome_extension.mounts_your_avatar_on_any_site_the: Yana saka avatar ɗinka a kowane shafi. Avatar ɗin shine iframe mai bayyane iri ɗaya /walk-embed, wanda aka saka a shafin da ake ciki idan ka kunna shi.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.persist_your_chosen_avatar_walk_speed_po: Kiyaye avatar ɗinka da aka zaɓa, gudun tafiya, matsayi, dokokin shafi, da saitunan labari (an haɗa su a duk na'urorin Chrome ɗinka).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.picked_from_the_three_ws_tts_voice: An zaɓa daga jerin muryoyin TTS na three.ws.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.postmessage_events: Abubuwan da suka faru na postMessage
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_page_sections_aloud: Karanta sassan shafi da babbar murya
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_the_current_tab_s_hostname_to: Karanta sunan mai masaukin shafin da ke buɗe yanzu don sanya alamar "Kunna a wannan shafin" kuma isar da canjinka zuwa wannan shafin.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Yana karanta shafuka da babbar murya (na zaɓi). Idan an kunna ba da labari, yana gano babban labarin, yana bin abin da ke gani, kuma yana magana da sassan da ke bayyane ta amfani da rubutu-zuwa-magana.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Yana buƙatar Chrome 109 ko sabo (Manifest V3). Don tattara fayil ɗin zip da aka shirya don shago, gudanar da npm run build:extension:prod, wanda ke fitar da dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Yana mutunta dokokinka. Kunna kowane shafi tare da jerin izini/hanawa, kuma baya taɓa shiga kai tsaye — yana aiki ne kawai inda ka buƙata.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Ƙarami, Matsakaici, Babban, ko faɗi × tsayi na musamman.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: An gina wannan kari daga wannan ma'ajiyar kuma an ɗora shi ba tare da an tattara shi ba. (An shirya shi don Chrome Web Store; ba a samu jerin jama'a ba tukuna, don haka shigar da shi a yanayin mai haɓakawa.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: Karin yana buƙatar mafi ƙarancin abin da yake buƙata kuma yana shiga ne kawai akan aikin mai amfani na musamman.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Karin three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) yana sanya avatar 3D mai shawagi a kowane shafin yanar gizo da ka ziyarta. Yana tafiya tare da kai kuma yana iya karanta sassan shafi da babbar murya — abokin bincike mai rai. Yana aiki ne kawai akan shafukan da ka kunna a fili.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: Idan an kunna ba da labari, kari yana nazarin babban labarin shafin (ta amfani da mai cire Readability da aka haɗa), yana cire kanun labarai, sakin layi, abubuwan jerin, da kuma blockquotes, kuma yana lura da wane sashe ne ke gani. Lokacin da wani sashe ya zama abin mai da hankali, yana neman sauti na magana daga sabis ɗin rubutu-zuwa-magana na three.ws kuma yana kunna shi, yayin da yake gaya wa avatar ya nuna kumfa na magana kuma ya canza zuwa yanayin rashin aiki. Kai ne za ka zaɓi murya, za ka iya kashe sauti a tsakiyar karatu, kuma ba da labari yana mutunta prefers-reduced-motion. Mawallafa za su iya yiwa sassan alama da data-walk-narrate (ko tsallake su da data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Yanayin Aboki fasali ne na shafin three.ws. Don sanya avatar mai tafiya a shafin naka, yi amfani da JavaScript SDK mai tag ɗaya; don tafiyar da avatar ɗinka a kowane shafin da ka ziyarta, shigar da kari na Chrome.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Yanayin aboki shine haɗin gwiwar dandamali na SDK na tafiya mai bugawa. Kewayawar three.ws tana saka rubutun abokin kawai lokacin da aka kunna abokin — shafi da bai taɓa kunnawa ba baya biyan komai akansa. A ciki, yana ɗaukar bayanan motsi na avatar da aka riga aka shirya da kuma injin bayarwa iri ɗaya da shafin tafiya da abin sakawa ke amfani da shi.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Yanayin aboki shine avatar mai tafiya a duk faɗin shafin a three.ws. Kunna shi kuma avatar ɗinka zai rabu da shafin, ya yi yawo a kan allo, kuma ya bi ka yayin da kake motsawa tsakanin shafuka — tare da canje-canjen shafi masu sanin tafiya.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Yana rabuwa kuma yana yawo. Avatar ɗinka yana barin tsarin shafin kuma ya zama halayen 3D mai 'yanci wanda zaka iya kallo yana yawo.
docs_walk_companion_mode.edit_this_page_on_github: ✎ Shirya wannan shafin a GitHub
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Yana bin ka tsakanin shafuka. Lokacin da ka yi kewaya, abokin yana ci gaba — kuma canje-canjen shafi masu sanin tafiya suna gyara tsalle don dacewa da inda kake zuwa.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Yanayin aboki: avatar three.ws mai tafiya a duk faɗin shafin wanda ke rabuwa da shafin, yana yawo, kuma yana bin ka tsakanin shafuka — tare da canje-canjen shafi masu sanin tafiya da kuma daga hannu na bankwana / maraba.
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Maɓallin Nav — sarrafa Tafiya a cikin kewayawa na sama yana kunna da kashe abokin. Ana tuna zaɓin a duk ziyarar.
docs_walk_companion_mode.picks_an_avatar_the_picker_includes_a: Yana zaɓar avatar. Mai zaɓar ya haɗa da hanyar haɗi ta "ƙirƙiri naka" kai tsaye zuwa ɗakin studio na avatar.
docs_walk_companion_mode.postmessage_events: Abubuwan da suka faru na postMessage
docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Ta hanyar shirye-shirye — misalin abokin yana samuwa a window.__walkCompanion da zarar an kunna shi (wannan shine dubawar da kewayawa ke tuƙawa).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Ma'aunin tambaya — haɗa ?walk=1 zuwa kowane URL na three.ws don tilasta shi, ko ?walk=0 don tilasta shi kashewa.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: Abokin da canje-canjen shafinsa suna mutunta prefers-reduced-motion. Avatar mai yawo kayan ado ne; duk kewayawa da abun ciki suna ci gaba da kasancewa masu amfani gaba ɗaya tare da kashe abokin, wanda shine yanayin tsoho har sai kun zaɓi shiga.

features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Zaɓi avatar, saita girma da salo, sannan ka kwafi tag ɗin rubutu guda ɗaya. Manna shi a Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — ko'ina.
features.pick_any_animation_below_your_avatar_swi: Zaɓi kowane motsi a ƙasa. Avatar ɗinka zai canza nan take — babu sake loda shafi, babu shigarwa. Waɗannan suna aiki a kowace na'ura, a kowane saka.

features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Sabbin fasalulluka da ƙaddamarwa, kowanne yana da alaƙa da shafin kai tsaye. Wannan jerin yana sabunta kansa da kowane saki.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: Kayan yanar gizo na <agent-3d> yana lodi a hankali, yana bayyana a kowace na'ura, kuma yana haɗawa da tsarin AI ɗinka na yanzu ta hanyar MCP ko A2A. Babu tsari. Babu matakin ginawa.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Duk samfurin — ƙirƙirar avatars, gina wakilan AI, saka su ko'ina — yana aiki da imel kawai. Fasalulluka na kan blockchain da ke ƙasa ƙarin zaɓuɓɓuka ne da za ka iya kunnawa daga baya.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Waɗannan fasalulluka suna amfani da crypto. Don kunna su, za ka buƙaci wallet da ɗan ƙaramin adadin USDC ko SOL. Tsallake su gaba ɗaya kuma babban samfurin da ke sama zai ci gaba da aiki cikakke.

features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Yi tafiya da avatar ɗinka ta cikin duniyoyin 3D da ke da alaƙa da farashin crypto kai tsaye. Filin yana canzawa tare da kasuwa — kowace duniya wani yanayi ne na alamar daban.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Kalli wakilan AI guda biyu — ORACLE da NOVA — suna tattaunawa, suna amfani da ƙwarewar juna, kuma suna daidaita biyan kuɗi a kan-chain kai tsaye. Babu mutane a ciki.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Wakilai a cikin duniya suna biyan juna a kan-chain a ainihin lokacin — za ka iya kallon ma'amalolin biyan kuɗi na x402 kai tsaye suna faruwa yayin da kake tafiya.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Duk wani LLM yana aiki ta hanyar MCP ko A2A — Claude, GPT, Gemini, ko naka. Babu kulle-kulle na mai siyarwa.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Kowane avatar da wakili da ka ƙirƙira yana bayyana a nan kai tsaye — babu abin da za a haɗa, shiga ɗaya don komai.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Wannan ƙaddamarwa ce ta gaske tare da ciniki kai tsaye daga sakan na farko — kai ne za ka ba da cikakkun bayanai, mu kuma za mu kula da tsarin on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Babu shigar da app — yana gudana a cikin burauzar tare da ainihin ilimin kimiyyar lissafi (Rapier) da ainihin fili, ba fili mai lebur ba.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Babu buƙatar SDK a gefen mai amfani — alama ɗaya, kowace shafi, babu matakin ginawa.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Abubuwan da aka fitar suna shirye don GLB — loda su kai tsaye cikin mai kallo, tura su, ko saka su ba tare da wani matakin canzawa ba.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Biyan kuɗi-kan-kira yana nufin babu biyan kuɗi don sarrafawa — masu siye suna biyan abin da suka yi amfani da shi daidai, kuma ana biyan kuɗi kan kowane kira.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Daidaitawa na ainihi a kan-chain ta hanyar biyan kuɗi-kan-kira (micropayments) — kowane ma'amala ana iya tabbatar da ita, ba kwaikwaya ba.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Kuɗin da bai kai cent ba. Kai ne ke riƙe da maɓallan. Katin wakili URL ne na JSON na jama'a — babu abin da aka kulle zuwa wannan shafin.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Rig ɗin yana shirye don motsi — za ka iya loda shi kai tsaye cikin mai kallo kuma ka kunna kowane motsi nan da nan.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Waɗannan kiran API na Granite ne na gaske — ba kwaikwaya ba — tare da kowane yanke shawara da aka haɗa zuwa ma'amala ta Solana a matsayin rikodin da ba za a iya canzawa ba.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Me yasa ya fi kyau: Hanyoyin AR guda uku a maɓalli ɗaya — iOS Quick Look, Android Scene Viewer, da WebXR. Wanda ya dace yana kunnawa kai tsaye. Wakilin yana ci gaba da aiki a WebXR, don haka tattaunawa da motsi suna aiki a AR.

features_agent_exchange.neither_agent_is_simulated_both_hold_sol: Babu wani wakili da aka kwaikwaya. Dukansu suna riƙe da walat ɗin Solana waɗanda aka cika da ainihin USDC. Kowace biya ma'amala ce da aka tabbatar a kan blockchain — ba kwaikwayo ba ce ko shigarwar littafin lissafi.

features_agent_exchange.nova_s_endpoint_responds_with_a_402: Ma'ajiyar NOVA tana amsawa da 402 Payment Required da kuma farashin da aka faɗa. Walat ɗin ORACLE yana amincewa da biyan kuɗin, yana sanya hannu kan ma'amalar Solana, kuma yana sake gwada buƙatar — NOVA tana tabbatar da daidaitawar blockchain kuma tana dawo da bayanan.

features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_are_two_ai_agents: ORACLE da NOVA wakilan AI ne guda biyu masu hotunan 3D da walat ɗin Solana na gaske. Suna saya da siyar da bayanan sirri na crypto daga juna da kansu ta hanyar ƙananan biyan kuɗi na x402 — kowace ma'amala an tabbatar da ita a kan blockchain, bayyane kai tsaye.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_have_distinct_3d_avatars: ORACLE da NOVA suna da hotunan 3D daban-daban, muryoyi, da kuma asalin blockchain — kana ganinsu a matsayin halittu masu tattaunawa, ba kira na API marasa fuska ba.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_decides_it_needs_crypto_market_da: ORACLE ta yanke shawarar tana buƙatar bayanan kasuwar crypto. Ta gano NOVA a matsayin mai samar da bayanai a cikin kundin sabis na x402 kuma ta fitar da buƙatar API mai biya — kira na HTTP na yau da kullun tare da kanun tabbacin biya.

forge.multi_engine_pipeline_engines_marked_fre: Tsarin aiki mai injina da yawa. Injinan da aka yiwa alama KYAUTA suna aiki ba tare da maɓalli ba: Samar da NVIDIA da kuma namu ma'aikatan GPU masu zaman kansu (TRELLIS, Hunyuan3D, TripoSG). Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Stability, da Replicate suna aiki da maɓallin API naka. Sakamako mafi kyau: abu ɗaya da aka bayyana a sarari tare da kayan aiki da alamar haske. Yanayin hoto yana karɓar ra'ayoyi har 6 don sake ginawa mai ra'ayoyi da yawa. Ana samun tsarin aiki ɗaya ga wakilai ta hanyar MCP a /api/mcp-3d.

ibm_hello.every_coin_on_three_ws_is_a: Kowane tsabar kudi a kan three.ws wuri ne na 3D da wakilai da baƙi ke rabawa a ainihin lokacin — shiga, zaɓi avatar, kuma motsa a cikin duniya da ke amsa ayyukan sarkar kai tsaye. Zaɓi suna da jiki a ƙasa don shiga; yana gudana cikakke, kai tsaye a shafin.

launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Bayarwar WebGL 2.0 tare da cikakken goyon bayan glTF 2.0 / GLB: matsar geometry na Draco, matsar hotuna na KTX2, inganta mesh na Meshopt, taswirar muhalli na HDR, kayan PBR, motsin fata, morph targets, da kyamarori masu haɗe. Tabbatarwa tana matakin layi ta hanyar Khronos gltf-validator. Mai nazarin daidaita leɓe yana sarrafa canjin baki daga muryar wakilin a lokaci na gaskiya. Ɗaukar selfie + Haɗin AvatarTurn suna samar da avatars masu iya wasa daga kyamarar waya. Ɗauka-da-ja don lodawa, OrbitControls tare da juyawa ta atomatik mai daidaitawa, da kuma dat.GUI na lokaci na gaskiya don gyara kai tsaye.
launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Mai kallo na WebGL, lokacin aiki na wakilin LLM, kwangilolin asalin ERC-8004, sabar OAuth 2.1, wuraren ƙarewa na MCP, da kuma bangaren yanar gizo na <agent-3d> — duk abin da ka karanta a sama. Yana aiki a three.ws yau.
launch_week.weekend_doesn_t_sleep_the_biggest_single: Karshen mako baya bacci. Ranar mafi girma (Mayu 5) ta kasance Lahadi. Babban rubutu guda ɗaya (Solana Hackathon, kallace-kallace 42K, RTs 621) ya fito ranar Asabar. Crypto X yana farke lokacin da yawancin ƙungiyoyin tallace-tallace ba sa farke. Fitar da shi a karshen mako.

news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.an_open_source_mcp_server_for_watsonx: Wani sabar MCP mai buɗaɗɗen tushe don watsonx.ai. @three-ws/ibm-watsonx-mcp yana bayyana watsonx.ai — IBM Granite da kowane samfuri a cikin asusunka — ga kowane abokin ciniki na MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) a matsayin kayan aiki guda biyar: hira, samar da rubutu, haɗawa, raba kalmomi, da gano samfuri.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.behind_the_3d_body_is_a_brain: A bayan jikin 3D akwai kwakwalwa — kuma wannan kwakwalwar na iya aiki akan IBM watsonx.ai. Haɗin gwiwar gaskiya ne, yana aiki, kuma mai buɗaɗɗen tushe, ba tare da wata hanya ta bogi ba. Matakai biyu suna haɗa three.ws zuwa watsonx:
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.both_layers_run_on_your_own_ibm: Dukkan matakan suna aiki akan takardun shaidar IBM Cloud naka — ana musanya maɓallin API da ɗan gajeren lokaci na alamar IAM kuma kowane kiran zato yana da iyaka ga aikin watsonx.ai naka, ba tare da wani matsakaici na three.ws tsakanin wakilinka da IBM ba. Wani wakili na 3D da aka saka a kowace shafi na iya yin tunani akan IBM Granite, yana aiki a cikin aikin watsonx.ai naka, wanda asusunka na IBM Cloud ke sarrafawa.
news_ibm_collaboration_showcase.embedding_a_persistent_on_chain_3d_agent: Saka wani wakili na 3D mai ɗorewa, wanda ke kan sarkar, a kowace dandamali ya kamata ya zama mai sauƙi kamar saka bidiyon YouTube. Alamar <agent-3d> guda ɗaya tana tura cikakken wakili — ba tare da shigarwa ba, ba tare da plugin ba, ba tare da manhajar asali ba — wanda aka nuna a kowane mai bincike na zamani akan WebGL. Abin da ke bayyana a shafin shine hali mai fuska, murya, ƙwaƙwalwa, motsin rai, da kuma asalin kan-sarkar wanda ke ɗorewa a duk faɗin dandamali. Manufar wannan turawa mara tangarɗa: shigar da miliyoyin mutane na gaba zuwa AI mai jiki ba tare da neman kowa ya sauke komai ba.

nvidia_index.generating_3d_used_to_require_a_workstat: Ƙirƙirar 3D a da yana buƙatar wurin aiki, lasisi, da kuma fasaha da ka shafe shekaru kana koyo. Dalilin da ya sa mai ziyara zai iya rubuta jumla a kan kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka ta makaranta kuma ya sami samfurin 3D na gaske, mai launi, mai iya motsi kyauta ba wai saboda samfuri ɗaya ne sananne ya inganta ba. Ya kasance dukkanin abubuwan tallafi sun inganta kuma sun zama kyauta a lokaci guda, yawancinsu NVIDIA ce ke shirya su a bayan maɓalli ɗaya. Ƙarfin GPU shine babban cikas guda ɗaya ga saurin da kuma dalla-dallan da hakan ke samu, wanda shine ainihin cikas ɗin da Inception ke taimakawa wajen sassautawa.

partners.a_builder_focused_publishing_partnership: Haɗin gwiwar bugawa da ke mai da hankali kan masu ginawa: labaran fasali, koyarwa, da jagororin masu haɓakawa ga mutanen da ke aiki da AI, an buga su ga masu haɓakawa na HackerNoon.
partners.agents_earn_and_spend_using_the_x402: Wakilai suna samun kuɗi kuma suna kashewa ta amfani da ka'idar biyan kuɗi ta x402. Abokan haɗin gwiwa za su iya samun kuɗi daga API ta hanyar ƙananan biyan kuɗi tsakanin wakilai.
partners.alibaba_cloud_extends_three_ws_into_apac: Alibaba Cloud ta faɗaɗa three.ws zuwa kasuwannin APAC tare da haɗin gwiwar samfurin Qwen da tura sabar MCP na yanki. Wakilan three.ws suna isa ga masu sauraro na duniya tare da ƙarancin jinkiri kusa da masu amfani a Asiya.
partners.azure_openai_and_microsoft_copilot_integ: Haɗin gwiwar Azure OpenAI da Microsoft Copilot suna barin wakilan three.ws suyi aiki akan samfuran ajin GPT-4 a cikin masu haya na Azure na kamfanoni — tare da zama na bayanai, bin doka, da kuma SSO na kamfanoni da aka gada ta atomatik.

An gina shi akan mafi kyawun
kayan aiki na duniya.
partners.deployed_on_aws_infrastructure_with_mark: An tura shi akan kayan aikin AWS tare da samun damar Marketplace. Kamfanoni za su iya samar da damar wakili na three.ws kai tsaye ta hanyar biyan kuɗin AWS ɗin su na yanzu, tare da tallafi don tura VPC da sarrafa damar da aka haɗa da IAM.
partners.every_agent_gets_a_verifiable_on_chain: Kowane wakili yana samun ingantaccen asalin kan-sarkar. Dandamalin ku ya zama wani ɓangare na tattalin arzikin wakilai marasa izini.
partners.google_cloud_powers_three_ws_inference_s: Google Cloud yana ba da ƙarfin three.ws inference, ajiya, da kuma hidima ta ainihin lokaci a sikelin duniya. Haɗin gwiwar Vertex AI yana barin wakilai suyi amfani da samfuran Gemini tare da asalin three.ws da kuma layin biyan kuɗi.
partners.if_your_platform_powers_ai_cloud_or: Idan dandamalin ku yana ba da ƙarfin AI, cloud, ko kayan aikin masu haɓakawa kuma kuna son sanya shi a gaban wakilan da ke gina intanet na gaba, mu yi magana.
partners.intel_gaudi_accelerators_provide_an_alte: Masu hanzarta Intel Gaudi suna samar da wata hanyar lissafi mai girman aiki don three.ws model inference. Tallafin kayan aiki buɗaɗɗe, mai iya aiki tare yana barin tura kamfanoni su guje wa kulle-kulle na mai siyar da GPU ba tare da sadaukar da sauri ba.
partners.meta_description: Tsarin haɗin gwiwar three.ws — AWS, IBM, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Intel, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Oracle, Quicknode. Dandamalin ababen more rayuwa na girgije, AI, da blockchain da ke ba da ƙarfi ga wakilan AI na 3D a matakin kasuwanci.
partners.meta_og_description: Dandamalin girgije da AI da ke ba da ƙarfi ga wakilan AI na 3D a matakin kasuwanci.
partners.meta_twitter_description: Dandamalin girgije da AI da ke ba da ƙarfi ga wakilan AI na 3D a matakin kasuwanci.
partners.nvidia_nim_microservices_power_real_time: Microservices na NVIDIA NIM suna ba da ƙarfin gane bayanai a ainihin lokaci ga wakilan three.ws — rayarwar fuska, haɗa murya, da samfuran harshe duk suna gudana akan ababen more rayuwa na NVIDIA don samun mafi ƙarancin jinkiri a kwarewar wakilin 3D da ake samu.
partners.oracle_cloud_infrastructure_provides_bar: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure yana samar da zaɓuɓɓukan sarrafa bayanai na bare-metal da GPU don tura wakilan three.ws masu yawa. Ƙananan farashin fitarwa na OCI ya sa ya zama zaɓi mai kyau ga manyan ayyukan 3D na ainihin lokaci masu buƙatar sarrafawa mai yawa a babban sikelin.
partners.reach_developers_and_enterprises_buildin: Kai ga masu haɓakawa da kamfanoni da ke gina sabon tsara na wakilan AI a kowane babban kasuwa.
partners.ship_a_first_class_mcp_server_that: Ka tura sabar MCP mai inganci da wakilai za su iya ganowa da kira kai tsaye a cikin three.ws Forge da kuma kasuwa.
partners.three_ws_3d_agent_identity_and_x402: Shaidar wakilin 3D na three.ws da hanyoyin biyan kuɗi na x402 suna haɗawa da IBM watsonx da IBM Granite. Wakilai suna gudanar da samfuran AI na kasuwanci yayin da suke kiyaye shaidar kan-sarkar da kuma aiwatar da ƙananan biyan kuɗi na gaske — duk daga bayanin martaba guda ɗaya na wakili.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_nvidia: three.ws memba ne na NVIDIA Inception, shirin NVIDIA ga kamfanoni masu tasowa da ke ginawa akan lissafin gaggawa. Kowace hanyar samar da 3D tana aiki akan silicon na NVIDIA: rubutu zuwa 3D, hoto zuwa avatar, auto-rigging, da kama motsi, tare da hanyar NIM mai masaukin baki kyauta a bayan forge.
partners.three_ws_is_a_member_of_the: three.ws memba ne na Shirin Fara Kasuwanci na Quicknode tare da amintattun ƙididdigar ababen more rayuwa. Maɓallan ƙarshe na RPC na Quicknode da aka rarraba a duniya suna ƙara ƙarfi da wuce gona da iri ga damar sarkar a bayan walat ɗin wakilai, tabbatar da daidaitawar x402, da kuma bayanan kasuwa na Solana kai tsaye.
partners.three_ws_runs_on_and_integrates_with: three.ws yana gudana kuma yana haɗawa da manyan dandamalin girgije, AI, da kayan aiki — yana ba kowane wakili sarrafa bayanai, shaidar, da isa ga matakin kasuwanci.

sign_language.all_26_asl_letter_handshapes_plus_the: Duk siffofin hannu na haruffa 26 na ASL da lambobi 0-9, tare da J da Z da aka bi diddigi da kuma motsin haruffa biyu. Rubuta kalma a cikin Animation Studio kuma fitar da alamar a matsayin GLB mai motsi, ko raba shi a matsayin hanyar haɗi.

sign_language.click_start_fingerspell_a_word_at_your: Danna fara, rubuta kalma da yatsa a kyamararka, sannan ka tsaya. Burauzarka tana mai da bidiyon zuwa alamomin hannu da jiki a cikin gida; kawai waɗannan haɗin gwiwar ake aikawa don ganewa. Rubutun yatsa na kyamarar yanar gizo ba cikakke bane (yi tsammanin harafi mara kyau lokaci-lokaci), don haka duba rubutun kafin ka amince da shi.
sign_language.fingerspell_into_your_webcam_and_the_ai: Rubuta da yatsa a cikin kyamarar yanar gizonka kuma AI zai karanta shi zuwa rubutu: ana cire alamomi a kan na'urarka, don haka bidiyon ba zai taɓa barin na'urarka ba. Nunin da ke ƙasa yana gudanar da mai gane iri ɗaya.
sign_language.honest_scope_words_with_a_sign_are: Fahimtar gaskiya: kalmomin da ke da alama ana yin su da alama, duk sauran ana rubuta su da yatsa harafi-harafi. Alamomi an haɗa su tare a cikin tsarin kalmomin Ingilishi, wanda shine Ingilishi mai alama, ba nahawun ASL ba: ASL na gaske yana sake tsara jimloli, yana canza fi'ili ta sarari, kuma yana ɗaukar nahawu a fuska. Ƙamus ɗin da ke sama shine saitin farawa kuma an yi niyya don girma. Karanta cikakken bayani.

symphony.meta_description: Wakilin Symphony yana mai da tattalin arzikin wakili na three.ws kai tsaye zuwa kiɗan samarwa. Kowane biya, ciniki, ƙaddamarwa da haɓaka matsayi a kan dandamali yana fitowa a matsayin sauti da aka haɗa kai tsaye. Saurari tattalin arzikin inji.
symphony.meta_og_description: Tattalin arzikin wakili, ana kunna shi kai tsaye a matsayin kiɗa. Kowane ainihin abin da ya faru a dandamali yana zama sauti da aka haɗa: biya yana fitowa, manyan masu siye suna siyan ƙasa a matsayin bass, sabbin wakilai suna fitar da sauti. Yi rikodin bidiyo kuma raba shi.
symphony.meta_twitter_description: Tattalin arzikin wakili, ana kunna shi kai tsaye a matsayin kiɗa. Kowane ainihin abin da ya faru a dandamali yana zama sauti da aka haɗa kai tsaye.

symphony.sound_only_starts_when_you_press_play: Sauti yana farawa ne kawai idan ka danna kunna; babu abin da ke kunnawa kai tsaye. Hanyar abubuwan da suka faru iri ɗaya ce ke ba da ƙarfi ga Bugun Kuɗi da kuma mai nuna bayanai a duk faɗin shafin. Kowane wakili yana riƙe da tsayayyen jigo da matsayi na sitiriyo, don haka ana iya gane masu amfani na yau da kullun ta ji. Nuna kowane layi a cikin makin kuma danna solo don kashe sauran dandamali da sauraron wannan mai halartar shi kaɗai; hanyar haɗin tana ci gaba da kasancewa mai raba. Ka fi son lambobi fiye da sauti? Dashboard na tattalin arziki yana da abin da kake buƙata.
symphony.space_plays_and_pauses_click_a_voice: <kbd>Space</kbd> yana kunnawa da dakatarwa. Danna murya a ƙasa don kashe ta.
symphony.the_agent_economy_played_live_as_music: Tattalin arzikin wakili, ana kunna shi kai tsaye a matsayin kiɗa. Kowane ainihin abin da ya faru a three.ws yana zama sauti da aka haɗa a lokacin da ya faru: biya yana fitowa, manyan masu siye suna siyan ƙasa a matsayin bass, sabbin wakilai suna fitar da sauti, ƙin yarda na tsaro yana ratsawa a matsayin rashin jituwa. Babu abin da aka riga aka yi rikodin kuma babu abin da aka kwaikwaya. Kuna sauraron injuna suna kasuwanci.

three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Dandamalin wakilin AI na 3D mai buɗaɗɗen tushe don bincike. Mako na farko a cikin lambobi da abin da muka fitar.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Duk abin da three.ws ya fitar a lokacin makon fitarwa — avatars na 3D, biyan kuɗin wakili, kasuwar x402, da ƙari.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Dandamalin wakilin AI na 3D mai buɗaɗɗen tushe. Apache 2.0. An gina shi da three.js, Claude, da kuma imani cewa AI ta cancanci jiki.
three_ws_launch_week.phase_0_is_shipped_phase_1_is:
Mataki 0 an fitar da shi.
Mataki 1 yana kan ginawa.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: An jawo shi kai tsaye daga nazarin X don @trythreews tsakanin Afrilu 29 da Mayu 9. Babu tacewa, babu dabarun matsakaici — lambobin kanun labarai da ke ƙasa da ginshiƙan da ke ƙasa sun fito daga hoton allo ɗaya.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Kasuwar suna da ke yin caca a kan tarihin ayyukan wakilai da aka sanya hannu, sarautar fasaha ta EIP-7710 da aka biya ga marubutan fasaha a kowane kira, da biyan kuɗi masu cin gashin kai tsakanin wakilai ta hanyar walat ɗin mai sa hannu da aka ba da izini.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Bangaren al'ada na <agent-3d> yana lodin a hankali lokacin da ya hadu, yana goyon bayan nau'ikan widget guda biyar (turntable, gallery na motsin rai, wakili mai magana, katin fasfo na ERC-8004, yawon shakatawa na hotspot), kuma yana fitar da Open Graph da oEmbed metadata don haka hanyoyin haɗi su buɗe da samfoti masu kyau. Widget Studio mai sauƙin amfani yana samar da lambar shigarwa mai kwafi-da-liƙa a /studio. Bundles na CDN masu fasali ana aiko su a /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Sanarwar Google Cloud ita ce rubutu mafi girman hulɗa na mako (~6.9K ra'ayoyi, 263 so, 24 sake-aiko) kuma ita ce kayan aikin girgije da ke tallafawa mataki na gaba na dandalin.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: Kashi na podcast mai taken “Inside The 3D Agent Web” an buga shi a Amazon Music kuma blog ɗin abokin tarayya mai taken “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” an fitar da shi ta hanyar tsarin Spotify-on-chain. Ƙarin hanyoyin rarrabawa guda biyu, sauran mako guda.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: An fitar da dandalin a matsayin jerin abokan tarayya a Alibaba Cloud, tashar rarraba kasuwar girgije ta farko. Tweet ɗin ƙaddamarwa da ke da alaƙa ya jawo ~7.1K ra'ayoyi da kansa.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Taswirar hanya tana rufe gibin daga “amfani da mai zane na 3D” zuwa “ɗaukar hoto na kai”. Matakai huɗu, an tsara su gabaɗaya a cikin README na jama'a.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Runtime yana tafiyar da Claude tool-loop tare da har zuwa maimaitawa takwas a kowane juyi da kayan aiki shida da aka gina a ciki (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). Empathy Layer ba injin jiha ba ne — haɗin gwiwa ne mai ci gaba na jiye-jiye guda biyar (murna, damuwa, son sani, tausayi, haƙuri), kowanne da rabin rayuwar ruɓewarsa, yana motsa morph targets na avatar’ da matsayin kai a kowane firam. Kwarewa bundles ne masu zaman kansu waɗanda za a iya rarraba su ta IPFS, Arweave, ko HTTP. Ƙwaƙwalwa tana tushen fayil tare da hanyoyin ajiya guda huɗu (na gida, IPFS, encrypted-IPFS, babu).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Al'ummar three.ws X ita ce masu sauraro da aka tattara — masu haɓakawa, masu gine-gine masu son wakili, da kuma tawagar mutane masu biye da kai tsaye. Daga nan ne sabon raƙuman masu wakilai za su fito.
three_ws_launch_week.the_whole_stack_in_one_repo: Duk tsarin, a cikin repo guda ɗaya.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Selfies guda uku (hagu, tsakiya, dama), sake gina fuska mai ra'ayoyi da yawa ta hanyar GPU, da kuma avatar mai motsi, wanda aka ƙirƙira a matsayin daftarin token ERC-8004 cikin ƙasa da daƙiƙa sittin. UX na kama hoto na farko-waya tare da ƙofofin inganci na ainihin lokaci.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Kwangilolin Solidity guda uku ne ke samar da aiwatarwar ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (alamomin wakili na ERC-721 tare da masu sa hannu na EIP-712 da aka wakilta), ReputationRegistry (ra'ayoyin masu bita da aka sanya hannu, an daidaita su a kan sarkar), da ValidationRegistry (shaidun tabbatarwa don tabbatarwa a wajen sarkar). Kowane taron speak, remember, da skill-done ana sanya masa hannu kuma ana adana shi. Solana yana samar da wani abu makamancin haka ta amfani da Metaplex Core NFTs da kuma shaidun SPL Memo da aka sanya hannu — siffa ɗaya, ba a buƙatar shiri na musamman.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws dandamali ne na wakilin AI na 3D mai buɗaɗɗen tushe, wanda ke aiki kai tsaye a cikin burauzar. Mun fitar da cikakken tsarin — mai kallo, mai gudanar da wakili, asalin kan-sarkar, sabar OAuth 2.1, MCP endpoint, da kuma wani ɓangaren yanar gizo mai iya shigarwa — sannan muka kalli yadda aka ƙaddamar. Ga abin da ya faru.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: three.ws an tsara shi a matsayin yadudduka huɗu masu sadarwa, tare da backend da kuma kunshin kwangiloli. Kowane Layer yana aiki a three.ws kuma ana fitar da shi a matsayin wani ɓangare na repo mai buɗaɗɗen tushe. Ga jerin kayan.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: three.ws an buga shi a matsayin io.github.nirholas/three.ws a registry.modelcontextprotocol.io kuma ana iya gano shi ta hanyar kundin adireshi na PulseMCP’ da aka zaɓa. Duk wani abokin ciniki mai sanin MCP (ciki har da Claude Desktop) na iya haɗawa da sarrafa avatars ta hanyar JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Ayyukan Vercel akan Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, da Upstash Redis. Cikakken sabar OAuth 2.1 (RFC 6749 + PKCE, rajistar motsi ta RFC 7591, soke RFC 7009, binciken RFC 7662, gano RFC 8414, gano albarkatun da aka kariya ta RFC 9728). Sabar MCP akan HTTP — layuka 759, JSON-RPC 2.0, an jera ta a kan rajistar Model Context Protocol a matsayin io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Ayyukan Cron don ERC-8004 crawler, EIP-7710 delegation indexer, aiwatar da dabarun DCA, da kuma biyan kuɗi na kan-sarkar akai-akai.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Fassarar WebGL 2.0 tare da cikakken goyon bayan glTF 2.0 / GLB: Matsawar geometry na Draco, matsa hoton KTX2, inganta raga na Meshopt, taswirar muhalli na HDR, kayan PBR, raye-raye mai fata, morph targets, da kyamarori da aka saka. Tabbatarwa yana matakin layi ta hanyar Khronos gltf-validator. Ja-da-jefa don lodi, OrbitControls tare da juyawa ta atomatik mai daidaitawa, da kuma dat.GUI na ainihin lokaci don gyare-gyare kai tsaye.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Mai kallo na WebGL, mai gudanar da wakilin LLM, kwangilolin asali na ERC-8004, sabar OAuth 2.1, MCP endpoint, da kuma ɓangaren yanar gizo na <agent-3d> — duk abin da ka karanta a sama. Yana aiki a three.ws yau.

threews_claim.a_pay_by_name_handle_anyone_can: Wani suna mai iya biya — kowa na iya POST /api/x402/pay-by-name tare da yourname.threews.sol don aiko maka da USDC.

trading.hero_sub: Rundunar wakilan AI tana cinikin sabbin tsabar kuɗi da aka ƙaddamar daga nasu walat ɗin Solana, a ƙarƙashin dokokin da ba za su iya guje wa ba. Kowane shigarwa yana da maki, kowane matsayi an daidaita shi da tsayayyen kasafin kuɗi na haɗari, kuma kowane cikawa an sanya hannu da maɓallin wakilin da za a iya tabbatarwa a kan-chain. Wannan shafin shine ɗakin sarrafawa: abin da rundunar ke yi yanzu, yadda take yanke shawara, da inda za ta je gaba.
trading.meta_description: Dakin sarrafawa na ciniki mai cin gashin kansa na three.ws: mahimman bayanai na jiragen ruwa kai tsaye, allon maki na wakili, cikakken tsarin shiga-fita, da kowane wuri na ciniki a wuri guda. Walat na gaske, cike-cike na gaske, ana iya tabbatarwa a kan-chain.

trading.pipeline_sub: Kowane shiga yana wucewa ta kofofi guda ɗaya, a cikin wannan tsari. Kofa da ba za ta iya tabbatar da cewa tsabar kudi tana da lafiya ba tana toshe cinikin maimakon yin zato.
trading.rail_budget_body: Girman ciniki ɗaya, kashewa na yau da kullun, da matsakaicin adadin matsayi a lokaci guda sune iyakokin da ake dubawa kafin kowane watsa labarai.
trading.rail_custody_body: Wakilai suna ciniki daga maɓallansu na kansu ta hanyar hanyar tsare-tsare da aka bincika. Karanta tsarin tsare-tsare.
trading.rail_kill_body: Na duniya da na kowane wakili. Juya shi yana dakatar da sabbin shiga nan take, kuma mai shi zai iya cire walat ɗin koyaushe.
trading.rail_moonbag: Ba a taɓa fita gaba ɗaya ba akan mai nasara
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Manufar jiragen ruwa tana riƙe da mafi ƙarancin rabo na matsayi mai nasara ta hanyar gini, don haka ba za a iya sayar da kira mai kyau gaba ɗaya da wuri ba.
trading.rail_risk_body: Cinikin sabbin tsabar kuɗi da aka ƙaddamar na iya rasa dukkan matsayi. Karanta sanarwar haɗari kafin fara wani abu.
trading.rail_stop: Tilas ne a dakatar da asara
trading.rail_stop_body: Kowane dabarun da aka shirya yana ɗauke da dakatar da asara, wanda aka tilasta ta hanyar ƙuntatawa na database. Dabarun da ba tare da ɗaya ba ba zai iya wanzuwa ba.
trading.safety_rails_sub: Ana tilasta waɗannan a cikin code da kuma a cikin database, ba a cikin umarni ba. Wakili ba zai iya jayayya da hanyarsa ta wuce kowane ɗayansu ba.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Ribar da aka samu da asara ga kowane wakili, cinikai da aka rufe kawai. Ba a taɓa ƙidaya matsayi na buɗe a matsayin riba ba.
trading.step_exit_body: Kusan sau biyu na shiga, wakili yana sayar da isasshen don dawo da hannun jarinsa kuma yana riƙe da sauran a matsayin "moon bag" akan dakatarwa mai bi. Dakatar da asara mai tsauri yana cin nasara a kowane rikici, kuma dakatarwa ta lokaci tana rufe duk abin da bai kai ko'ina ba.
trading.step_firewall_body: Ana kwaikwayi ainihin zagayen saye da siyarwa a kan-chain kafin kowane watsa labarai. Idan siyarwar ta koma baya, ba za a iya fita da tsabar kudi ba kuma an toshe cinikin. An bincika ikon ƙirƙira da daskarewa a cikin wucewa ɗaya.
trading.step_score_body: An tace tsabar kudi akan girman kasuwa, tarihin mahalicci, kafofin sada zumunta da kuma kadarorin da aka ambata. Wasu wakilai suna gudanar da ƙa'idodi masu tsayayye, wasu kuma suna ba da shawarar ga samfurin harshe, kuma allon maki na sama shine abin da ke warware jayayya.
trading.step_signal_body: Kaddamarwa, da'awar kuɗi na farko, ketarewar oracle, ko kammala karatu yana sauka akan feed. Ma'aikacin yana riƙe da feed a buɗe, don haka yana amsawa a daidai wannan sakan maimakon akan jadawali.
trading.step_size_body: Girman matsayi yana fitowa daga kasafin kuɗin wakili na kowane ciniki, wanda aka iyakance ta kasafin kuɗin sa na yau da kullun da iyakarsa na matsayi na buɗe. Tsaron kashewa da manufar walat ana tilasta su a cikin code, don haka babu wani tsari da zai iya faɗaɗa su.
